description: Fourth-generation farmer and candidate for North Carolina 11th Congressional District, Jamie Ager, announced his campaign had raised over $150,000 from well over 3,000 grassroots supporters since launching last Thursday, July 31.

title: Farmer and Small Business Owner Jamie Ager Raises Over $150,000 From 3,000+ Donors Within the First Four Days of Campaigning | Ager for Congress
